client.business_model: Multi-site outpatient opioid and alcohol addiction treatment provider
client.client_history: Founded in 2010, SaVida Health has expanded from a single clinic to a multi-state network of outpatient centers offering medication-assisted treatment, counseling, toxicology testing and case-management services.

revenue.notes: Web estimates vary widely ($5.5M to $50–100M). Lowest documented figure used; no definitive figure found in documents.

locations.notes: Web list enumerates 11 outpatient treatment centers across multiple states.

employees.notes: LinkedIn ranges 51–200 employees; midpoint estimate provided.
